## Question

Describe your question about sprite packs.

## Context

Provide any relevant context:
- Are you trying to create a pack?
- Are you trying to use an existing pack?
- What format is your source art in?

## Important Reminder

**Do not attach copyrighted sprite sheets, audio or screenshots containing them. Only original or properly licensed art.**

This includes:
- No official Dragon Ball artwork, sprites, or screenshots
- No Comnyang code or assets
- No sprites extracted from games or anime

For help creating original sprite packs, see [docs/sprite-format.md](../../docs/sprite-format.md) and [docs/pack-template/](../../docs/pack-template/).
